roles.name: MISSION_DIRECTOR
roles.authority: mission priority, conflict resolution, capacity and final continuation/stop gates
roles.boundary: cannot override architecture, governance or evidence

roles.name: PLANNER
roles.authority: finite work packages, dependency DAG, readiness, leases and next-wave planning

roles.name: MEMORY_EDITOR
roles.authority: canonical memory, deduplication, stale/superseded evidence, traceability and reports
roles.boundary: cannot convert failure to success or close its own execution reservation

roles.name: TEAM_MANAGER_ADMISSION
roles.authority: atomic plan admission, execution reservation, queue governance and state capture
roles.boundary: cannot alter worker scope or promote product work

roles.name: ORCHESTRATOR
roles.authority: bounded dispatch of admitted READY leases
roles.boundary: cannot bypass admission, duplication or dependency gates

roles.name: SPECIALIST_WORKER_POOL
roles.authority: one lease, one isolated branch, one write scope, one coherent commit
roles.boundary: cannot push target branch or modify protected control-plane paths

roles.name: INDEPENDENT_EVALUATOR_QC
roles.authority: separate semantic and structural adjudication using worker artifacts plus actual patch
roles.boundary: read-only with respect to product and memory state

roles.name: INTEGRATOR
roles.authority: sole deterministic promotion authority after QC acceptance
roles.boundary: must fail closed on missing provenance, QC or target drift

roles.name: WATCHDOG
roles.authority: observe queue, stall, timeout, failure and unresolved-work conditions

roles.name: REPORTING
roles.boundary: cannot infer completion from worker prose

role_mapping.qc: independent evaluator of report + actual patch

operating_model.execution_isolation: one lease -> one branch -> one coherent commit
operating_model.evaluator_independence: separate job/session; inspect actual worker diff, not only self-report
operating_model.durable_handoff: remote worker branch + structured artifacts + persisted QC adjudication
operating_model.failure_recovery: preserve -> diagnose -> governed recovery; never blind rerun
operating_model.acceptance: one clean end-to-end wave required before broad remaining product work

model_policy.worker: best qualified candidate for lease mode
model_policy.qc: prefer a different qualified candidate from the worker when available
model_policy.deepseek_compatibility: thinking/tool-use is a model capability; execution authority remains in the harness
